text:
Raj P (AP): Heads up, Sunbeam Analytics sent invoice #A-455 with 0% VAT to our EU billing entity. They included VAT ID: ESX12345678. Invoice flags reverse charge. Should we process net?

Marisol T (Tax): I'll validate the ES VAT ID in VIES. Also need their company registration name to match the invoice. If it's B2B and VIES OK, reverse charge ok.

Raj P (AP): Attached invoice (A-455.pdf) — billed from Madrid. Company name on invoice: Sunbeam Analytics SL.

Owen (Vendor): Confirming Sunbeam is Spanish and VAT registered. We attached our VAT certificate to the portal yesterday.

TaxBot: VIES lookup for ESX12345678 1:30UTC 1/03/2025 1: Result: VALID (Name: SUNBEAM ANALYTICS SL)

Marisol T (Tax): VIES returned valid and name matches. Reverse charge acceptable. Please ensure the invoice references Article 196 and includes our VAT number.

Lina (Finance Ops): AP note: we need the invoice to state "reverse charge" and include both VAT numbers. Current invoice lacks our VAT number. Can vendor reissue quickly?

Raj P (AP): Reached out asking for reissue with our VAT ID and reverse charge reference. Vendor replied: Can you accept as-is and we'll send a credit note later? They prefer not to reissue for time reasons.

Marisol T (Tax): Must have our VAT ID on the invoice to support our reclaim in the return. Accepting as-is is risky. If they won't reissue, ask for written confirmation stating the supply is B2B and will provide a corrected invoice within 30 days. Also capture the VAT cert copy.

Owen (Vendor): We can provide a signed statement and the VAT cert. We'll reissue in 10 days if absolutely required.

Lina (Finance Ops): For payment timing, can we hold until we get either the corrected invoice or the signed statement?

Raj P (AP): Payment is due EOD Friday. I propose we delay payment 7 days and mark as TAX_DOCS_PENDING.

Marisol T (Tax): Agreed. If they deliver the corrected invoice within 7 days, release net payment. If not, escalate to Finance Director for decision on gross-up or withholding. Note: gross-up increases expense; withholding doesn't apply for VAT.

TaxBot: Reminder: For EU B2B supplies, ensure invoices include both supplier and customer VAT numbers and reference to reverse charge.

Raj P (AP): Noted. I told vendor payment on hold and requested corrected invoice.

Owen (Vendor): Understood. We'll push accounting to reissue.

Lina (Finance Ops): I'll put AP hold tag and notify accounting.

Marisol T (Tax): Final: Release conditions: corrected invoice with both VAT IDs and reverse charge language OR signed VAT cert + written promise to correct within 30 days with traceable request. Otherwise escalate.

Raj P (AP): Thanks all, will update when invoice or cert arrives. :white_check_mark:
